steps: Get an instant quote by describing your device
Accept and ship free with the tracked prepaid label
Device inspected, usually within 24 hours of receipt
Confirm and receive payment within 24 hours after confirmation
timing: Most devices inspected within 24 hours of receipt; payment sent within 24 hours after confirmation.
who_pays: Swopsmart, the buyback company itself - they buy your device directly.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, in the US, and own the device. Only eligible devices are accepted.
work_available: Yes - the program was live on swopsmart.com as of 2026-09-23. It covers eligible devices; value varies by device, condition, and demand.
what_gets_accepted: The quote only holds if the device matches your description when inspected (usually within 24 hours of receipt). A mismatch means a revised offer - and payment only goes out after you confirm it.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No selling fees and free tracked shipping. Your unpaid time is getting the quote, packaging, transit, and waiting for inspection - the 'within 24 hours' clocks start when the device arrives, not when you ship.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash - payment is sent within 24 hours after you confirm the inspected offer. Confirm the offer email the moment it arrives; dawdling delays your money.
